correctness.rationale: The no-jump dissipative generator decomposes into the Laplacian cyclic subspace of three junction vectors (all decaying) and dark orthogonal complement, since any real eigenmode in bright space would vanish on all positive-loss sites, contradiction. Rational boundary Schur complement uses symmetric/standard channels; polynomial recurrences r_{j+1}=r_j(5-r_j), q_{j+1}=(3-r_j)q_j-r_j. Exact Bezout identities and algebraic-integer arguments preclude numerator/denominator cancellation at any generation; reduced junction-resolvent denominators degrees 1+3*2^(g-2) (symmetric) and 5*2^(g-2) (standard), multiplicity 1+2* respectively yields rank B_g=1+13*2^(g-2). The g=1 direct resolvent yields rank 6. Independent symbolic Bezout verification and exact modular Krylov ranks g=1..4 equal 6,14,27,53. Finite ranks are supporting checks, not the all-generation proof.
